levelz.port.assets.pack_description: Textures, models and translations from your original LevelZ jar
levelz.port.assets.title: LevelZ — unofficial NeoForge port
levelz.port.assets.text: The original textures, models, sounds and translations are copyrighted (All Rights Reserved), so they are not included in this port. Download the original mod for Fabric 1.21.1 and put the jar into the resourcepacks folder — the port will use only its graphics and translations from it. You do not need to put it into the mods folder.
